label: D2 after a1 led rarely to S2, following rewarded trials
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a1 and the rare transition took it to S2 (in_action=a1, in_state=S2): every activation falls in this condition. Within it, activity needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (99% of mass; almost silent when prev_reward=0) and is helped by the trial before that not being unrewarded. The prior trials are nearly always a1 and S1 is usually the good state, so this is an a1-to-S2 surprise after a run of rewarded a1 choices. Everything in the predicate is observed at D2. Precision is only about 0.48: many steps that match look the same as the active ones, so whether it crosses threshold depends on continuous state. Active steps fall in the near-neutral choice-logit bin (-1.5 to 2.8), and adding that bin raises dev F1 to 0.64, but that is a model readout and is not used here. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, or on common transitions. Magnitude is small (max 0.004). Dev: P 0.47, R 0.96, F1 0.63, mass recall 0.99.
